recorded: 2026-10-22, before any future_k2 RL result was inspected (user instruction 2026-10-22: train and evaluate future prediction + Chamfer only if the results indicate that future prediction provides meaningful improvements and is worth adopting)
question: Does future_k2 (runs/setup/afk2-definition-20261020.json) improve over the original method (method-frozen-v1: C + D0 + M3D, 200k) enough to adopt it?

primary_endpoint.metric: DrM evaluation success rate, last-5 (mean of the final five evaluation points of each run), training-camera group
primary_endpoint.runs: future_k2: afk2-drm-<task>-s2000..s2002; original: the completed s3-drm-splatter4d-<task>-s2000..s2002 (frozen-encoder DrM, 1M agent steps, same evaluation protocol; evaluation episode seeds depend only on the run seed and evaluation index)
primary_endpoint.aggregate: interquartile mean over runs (tasks x seeds) of future_k2 minus that of the original, with a task-stratified bootstrap 95% interval (B = 2000), the campaign's established RL aggregation

decision_points.D1: all six pilot-task runs (hammer, pick-place x 3 seeds) of future_k2 evaluated to 1M steps
decision_points.D2: all 24 runs (eight tasks x 3 seeds) evaluated to 1M steps

rule: Adopt if, at D1 or at D2, the IQM difference is >= 0.05 success and its 95% interval lies above 0. At D1 an interval that includes 0 defers the decision to D2 (no adoption). If D2 does not meet the rule, future_k2 is not adopted and the combined variant is not run; this is documented.

on_adoption.variant: afk2chl: base + task + variants/future_k2.yaml + variants/chamfer_lean.yaml (future prediction exactly as future_k2; the Chamfer term exactly as chamfer_lean, applied to the decoded centres of the target window (t, t+k2, t+2*k2) against the training cameras' fused depth of those frames; the depth-gradient, hard-depth and visibility terms skipped as in chamfer_lean)
on_adoption.protocol: eight tasks, seed 0, 200k pretraining, export, DrM seeds 2000-2002 1M steps with evaluators, identical to the future_k2 and chamfer_lean rows
on_adoption.prerequisites: a compatibility test and a smoke run of the combined configuration through the established worktree / full-suite workflow before registration

not_used_for_the_decision: chamfer_lean RL results, any tuning toward RL results
